tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa'i gsang khrid kyi sgrub thabs 'dzam bu'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal lung yongs// tshul bzhin 'doms pa'i mtshan nyid 'dir rdzogs zhes// yid ches 'phrin gyis rab bsngags rdo rje yi// slob dpon 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtsug na rol// che mchog yon tan rdzogs pa'i gom stabs kyis// mi phyed rdo rje'i go sar bcal byas kyang*// rgyal bstan bskyang phyir zhing skyong dbang po'i skur// nyer sprul las bzhi lhun grub gdong bzhi pa// gang gi sgrub tshul gdams pa'i rgya mtsho las// ches zab snying po'i zil mngar la brten nas// mthar thug sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan srog /'pho bral rtag pa'i cho ga rgyun 'khyer brtsam// de la 'dir zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gsang sgrub kyi gdams pa thob pas rgyun chags nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ma rgyud spyi ltar byas la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnas khang dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i nang*/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa/ de'i spyi bor skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma sku gur gyi mgon po'i rnam pa can/ de'i spyi bo nas yar rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub dang nam mkha' dpal bzang tha mi dad pa/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ dbang phyug rab brtan/ bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ bkra shis seng ge skyes mchog rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas mchog dge ba rgyal mtshan/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ rje bdag nyid chen po/ ā nanda dam pa/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/

bsod nams rtse mo/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ gnam kha'u pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ rin chen grags pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ dri med sbas pa/ dpal bde ba/ mar me mdzad/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ ba linta pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi bar gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams gur gyi mgon po'i rnam pa sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid can tho brtsegs su bdag la dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang srung mar bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs nas/ de dag la thim pas thams cad skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs dang*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs shlau ka res bstod la/ re re bzhin du gsol ba 'debs pa'am/ mi nus na/ bstan srung dbang po'i bka' srol gdams ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la skyabs su mchi'o// gsol ba 'debs so// byin gyis rlobs shig zhes gsol ba btab pas/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhing skyong dbang po 'khor bcas bdag gi dbang du 'dus nas las bzhi'i phrin las thams cad 'bad med du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'og gi chos skyong 'khor bcas 'od du zhu nas bla ma la thim/ maṇḍal 'bul ba'i skabs yin na 'dir gsog go /bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi gzugs su byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du rim dang cig car du thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa byang nas sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag

bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du cung zad 'jog gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur pa'i dbus su/ padma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du hūm̐ las rang nyid rdo rje gur gyi mgon po sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje nag po chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ yi ge bdun pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// de tsam mi nus na padma dang nyi ma mi ro'i steng du rang skad cig gis rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag gri gug dang thod pa dang gaṇḍi 'dzin pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa khro bo'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i skur gyur/ zhes skad cig gis gsal btab kyang rung ngo*// gnyis ka ltar yang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rdo rje gur gyi mgon po dang stobs 'phrog dbang po yum bzhi dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim pas/ rang gi lus kyi nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rnams lam gyis gsal bar gyur te/ spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar rtsa dbu ma sngo bsangs thig le'i dwangs mas gang ba/ g.yas su ro ma dmar gsal rakta'i dwangs mas gang ba/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar dwangs byang chub sems kyis gang ba/ yar rtse spyi bo nas gug ste smin mtshams dang sna bug gnyis la zug pa/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rnams rtsa 'dab gyes pa/ gsang gnas rtsa gsum gyi 'dus mdor chos 'byung gru gsum smug nag gdeng kha che ba lte 'og sor bzhir slebs pa'i nang*/ yum chen g.yung mo nag mo gri gug dang thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i lte bar yum chen e ka dzā ṭi sku mdog sngo bsangs phyag gnyis kyis g.yu'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de gnyis las 'od sngon po zhig chad/ dbu mar brgyud/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum 'od dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pas/ rtsa 'khor gyi stod tsam du bla ma gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ gri gug dang thod pa gaṇḍi 'dzin pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ khro bo'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i skur gyur/ bla ma gur mgon gyi thugs ka nas 'od sngon po zhig chad pa chos 'khor gyi dbus su 'dres pa las stobs 'phrog dbang po'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ phyogs bzhir yum chen bzhi'i ngo bo rang mdog dang mthun pa'i hūm̐ re re nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa/

bla ma gur mgon hūm̐ yig lnga dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bstan srung thams cad/ bla ma gur mgon zhing skyong dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥso sor gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga gong ltar spyan drangs/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣañtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gur mgon spyi bor mi bskyod pa dang*/ gzhan rnams la rdo rje sngon pos dbur brgyan/ dgur mgon gyi phyag na dam tshig gi rdo rje thogs te/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs// gal te dam las 'das gyur nas// 'jig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas dam la bzhag gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥs byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥsogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ nang gi bla ma yig 'bru lnga dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dang*/ nag po chen po sgrub pa la gegs byed kyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer sna bug nas phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma dang nag po chen po rnams mchod pas mnyes par byas/ bdag gi dbang du gyur nas 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur bsdus rang la thim pas gzi brjid cher rgyas shing*/

bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍombi ni/ tsaṇḍa li/ rakṣa si/ siṃ ga li hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ zhes pa ci nus bzla'o// de nas nang gi bla ma dang yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dug lngas bskyed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams khyab pas dug lnga'i rtog pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ de dag dang phyi'i dregs byed sangs rgyas byang sems dang bcas pa thams cad ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer lnga'i rnam par zhu ba/ nang gi lha tshogs rnams la thim pa'i rkyen gyis yi ge lnga 'od du zhu nas bla ma la thim/ de'ang 'od sngon por bde stong gi rang bzhin du gyur te/ lus thams cad khyab pas bde chen gyi ye shes skyes par bsam/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal la rlung kha sbyar bsgom mo// gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ sgom pa lha'i gnad/ dam bzhag rdzas kyi gnad/ bsnyen pa sngags kyi gnad/ las mkhan myang 'das kyi gnad/ gsang rten lus la sba ba'i gnang ngo*/ /gnad lnga'i sgo nas nyams su len pa la rang rdo rje gur mgon gnas gyur pa'i tshul gyis stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa'i skur gyur pa ni/ padma dang nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la skad cig gis nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po ro za ba/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas rtse gsum dang g.yon 'og mas mdung rnon 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa'i mchan khung na bum pa dang rus phreng phyag 'gag tu brgyus pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/

tshangs pa'i skud pa dang rus pa'i rgyan dang dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ de'i pang na yum e ka dzā ṭi mas 'khyud cing*/ drag la rngam pa'i cha byad kyis/ dam nyams dgra bo'i steng na 'jigs pa'i bro brdung ba'i skur gsal ba/ de'i lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ lte 'og chos 'byung gi nang du yum chen gnyis dang bcas par gsal bar gyur pa'i/ yum chen gnyis las 'od sngon po gsum byung*/ lte ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsa thig rlung gsum 'od dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rtsa 'khor gyi stod tsam du bla ma gur gyi mgon po gsum du gyur/ de gsum las 'od sngon po gsum chad pa las/ dbus su stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa rtsa zhal sngon po sogs nas/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de'i pang na yum e ka dzā ṭi mas 'khyud pa/ brkyang bskum dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su ro ma dang dbyer med pa'i srin mo dmar mo dang g.yung mo nag mo gnyis/ g.yon du rkyang ma dang dbyer med pa'i siṅga li ser mo dang gtum mo ljang gu/ gnyis te yum bzhi mgon po las cung zad dma' bar bsgom/ bzhi ka'ang gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gcer mo rgyan med pa g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis gtso bo la phyogs par bzhengs pas/ bla ma gur mgon gsum las shā sa na'i sngags phreng mthing ga me 'bar ba 'phros pas/ 'og gi yab yum lnga rgya gram du bcings pas skrag cing 'dar ba'i rnam par gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral mgrin snying ga gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sogs ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ dam bzhag mchod gtor 'bul ba rnams gang bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir rtsa zhal nag pos g.yas kyi srin mo la gzigs pas yum chen bde bas mnyes nas 'od du yal 'gro la khad pa dang*/

yum chen srin mos kyang rtsa zhal la gzigs pas de nyid bde bas mnyes nas 'od du yal la khad par bsam/ de bzhin du g.yas zhal dang g.yung mo/ g.yon zhal dang gtum mo// steng zhal dang siṅga li rnams phan tshun gzigs res kyi bde ba bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa bya ba ni bla ma gong ma'i zhal rgyun la bzhugs pa'o/ /bzhin bya'o// de nas rlung ro lan gsum bus la/ dmigs pa ni bla ma gur mgon gsum las 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ yab yum lnga la phog ste drag tu bskul bas/ de rnams las rang 'dra'i sprul pa drag gtum dpag tu med pa sna bug gnyis nas phyir 'phros/ phyi rol gyi dregs byed rnams dang bcas pas stong gsum gang bas/ bstan pa dang rnal 'byor pa la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ de dag gi rnam shes dang bsod nams 'od kyi rnam par bsdus/ sprul pa rnams dang lhan cig sna bug nas zhugs/ nang gi bla ma chos skyong la thim pas/ srid gsum gyi dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mthu stobs phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ ma oṃ nag po chen po mche ba gtsigs/ hā kā la kā la bi kaṭṭa oṃ nag po chen po mche ba gtsigs/ kā ra la/ mchu 'phyang shugs che lambi ta o ṭha/ mchu 'phyang shugs che/ lamba ka be ka byis pa'i gzugs/ lamba ka ba le dril bu'i sgra sgrogs drag po ni/ rawi ghaṇḍa ru dra/ mā la bi phreng can dpa' zhing gcod par byed/

hu re tstshe da ha ka le/ ha le na ha le/ sha chan za byed ming grangs can/ pi mī dzā li/ bā me ghundi dha ri yaṃ ma eṃ/ g.yon na chang bum thod pa 'dzin/ da hi na kārti ka ka ro ṭi/ g.yas na gri gug ral gri can/ bi bhi ṣa ṇa dha eṃ/ 'jigs su rung ba'i mgyogs pa can/ bā me shu la lag pa g.yon par mdung thung thogs/ pā ṇi/ ha ra do ra na ra si mi mgo'i phreng ba'i do shal can/ ra mā la/ pā ta le kṣiṃ sa 'og tu ni kṣiṃ sgra sgrogs/ ka ra ka la/ ma hā po po ta la ri chen po na/ ṭa le/ ma hā kā la nag po chen po khyod bzhugs shing*/ shrī ka bi la/ ke la saṃ kṣe tra pā la/ ti se gangs la zhing skyong mdzad/ ha hā ha ha'i gad rgyangs ka hūm̐ hūm̐ sgrogs/ re/ pūrba bhā ṣa bhi sngon gyi skad du legs ldan khyod/ uṃ dzau dzanti/ māṃ sa sha rus sbyar zan me tog spos/ bha ta/ phulla dhū pa/ sha rus sbyar zan me tog spos/ i gha ha khyer cig gtor ma 'di zung zhig ba liṃ dzagha ha/ da sha phyogs bcu'i dbang phyug byang phyogs gnas/ dika utta ra wu ri/ ḍombi ni tsaṇḍa li g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang*/ rakṣa si/ siṃ ga li siṅga li ma lha mo kye/ de wi/ ha na ha na/ rgyob rgyob bandha bandha/ chings chings/ mā ra sod sod cig da ha da ha/ sregs sregs/ pa tsa pa tsa/ chos chos/ kṣiṃ kṣiṃ/ kṣiṃ kṣiṃ gyis/ le hi ba gtor ma 'di longs dngos grub stsal/ li de hi siddhi/ bi kā la rnam par gnag pa'i dgra rnams sod/ sha trū na nā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags ring ci rigs par bzlas/ de'i 'tshub cing ldog rtags byung na/ sngags ring bzlog ste gsum mam bdun tsam bzlas na 'jam zhing shis pa'i gnad do// gsum pa las sbyor ni/ bla ma nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/

mgon po 'khor bcas la phog pas/ 'dar zhing skrag pa dang*/ dgra bgegs la khro 'khrugs rngam pas rang 'dra'i sprul pa drag gtum mtshon cha thogs pa stong gsum khyab par spros/ de dag phyi rol dregs byed dang bcas pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra/ bdag cag chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sha khrag rus pa'i sogs zhal du bzhes nas rjes med du btang*/ rnam par shes pa rang sems ro gcig tu bsres la 'dzin med du bzhag sprul pa du mas tshur 'dus nang gi lha so so la thim par bsam/ de lta bu'i spro bsdu yang yang bya zhing*/ yab yum gyi sngags la gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsad sngags btags pa ci rigs bzla'o// thun las ldang ba na bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ yum chen bzhi las yum chen bzhi nam mkha' gang ba 'phros/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad yum chen bzhir gyur/ tshur 'dus nang gi yum bzhir thim pa'i rkyen gyis yum bzhi gdong bzhi pa la thim/ de las kyang rang 'dra'i sprul pa spros/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ gdong bzhi par gyur/ tshur 'dus nang gi dpal mgon la thim pas de'ang bla ma gur mgon la thim/ de las rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'phros/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ gur mgon du byas/ tshur 'dus nang gi bla ma gur mgon la thim/ g.yas g.yon gyi gur mgon yang dbus mar thim zhing*/ de 'od ser po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas lus thams cad gang bas bde chen gyi ye shes skyes par mos la rlung kha sbyar 'dzin/ mthar 'od zer de rnams tshur 'dus te snying gar thig le sngon po las bla ma gur mgon du gyur pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las chos skyong gi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po zhig chad/ 'od zer dmar po ba thag lta bu'i sna las bde hril gyis byung*/

lte 'og gi yum chen gnyis kyi spyi bo nas thogs med du zhugs/ gsang gnas padma dmar po kha bye ba'i ze'u 'bru'i khrod nas hūm̐ yig gi phyed tsam phyir 'thon pa la/ phyi rol gyi chos skyong dregs byed thams cad padma'i tshal du bung pa bzhin 'dus te thim pas byang chub bar du nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa 'bral med du 'grogs par bsams la sems 'dzin med kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa rjes ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo gdan dang bcas pa rang la thim/ rang nag po chen por gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nag po chen po 'grub gyur nas sogs kyis dge ba bsngos la spyod lam la 'jug go /'di ni bsnyen sgrub las gsum tshang bar rgyun par nyams su blang byar byas pa yin gyi/ bogs dbyung gegs sel sogs ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// smras pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' thub dbang brtul zhugs 'chang*// rmor chen rje dang dpal chos mkha' bzang sogs// tshul 'dir bka' drin che mchog thugs kyi bcud// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor 'dzam bu'i snye mas yur// nyams su legs bstar gnas skabs mthar thug gi /'bras bu nges par 'byung ba 'di bgyis pas// bha gi ra thas nyal 'gro ngal ba brgyas// phab pa'i dka' spyad snying por bshung ba snyam// de las byung ba'i bsod nams mkha' mnyam 'gro// rdo rje'i theg par tshul bzhin zhugs gyur nas// lta sgom spyod pa rnam dag phrin las kyis// chos dang sems can phan par 'byung phyir bsngo// zhes dpal mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa'i gsang sgrub kyi nyams blang 'dzam bu'i snye ma zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ gtsug lag kun gzigs bla ma bde 'byung rnams par rol pa'i bkas bskul ngor/

khrid yig brjod bya'i snying po bsdus nas/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
